en.text:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits with the weapon within 3 seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to apply <arc/>Jolt.

Being <arc/>Amplified decreases the number of Hits required.

Hits needed to activate normally | while <arc/>Amplified:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: <enhanced/>${18-#d} | <arc/>13
• Machine Guns: <enhanced/>${16-#c} | <arc/>11
• Auto Rifles: <enhanced/>${15-#d} | <arc/>11
• Pulse Rifles: <enhanced/>${14-#d} | <arc/>9
• Sidearms: <enhanced/>${10-#d} | <arc/>7
• Rocket Pulse Rifle: <enhanced/>${8-#d} | <arc/>5
• Scout Rifles, Hand Cannons: <enhanced/>${7-#c} | <arc/><enhanced/>${6-#b}
• Swords: <enhanced/>${6-#c} | <arc/><enhanced/>${4-#d}
• Glaives, Linear Fusion Rifles: <enhanced/>${4-#d} | <arc/>3 
• Rocket Sidearm, Sniper Rifle?: <enhanced/>${4-#d} | <arc/>2
• Bows, Grenade Launchers: <enhanced/>${3-#d} | <arc/>2
• Shotguns, Aggressive Frame Fusion Rifle: <enhanced/>${3-#d}|1<<arc/>
